items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) against rejection with Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
items.computation: The Klage period is one month from Bekanntgabe (deemed notification) of this Bescheid. Bekanntgabe for a letter posted by a German authority within Germany is deemed to occur three days after posting (§41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW, adjusted to the next business day if that third day is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday), and the one-month period then runs under §§187, 188 BGB from the day after Bekanntgabe, ending on the same-numbered day of the following month (shifted to the next business day if that day falls on a weekend or public holiday in NRW). However, the letter itself carries no visible issue/posting date (no 'Datum' line is printed on the extracted page) - only the applicant's request date of 02.07.2026 is mentioned, which is not the same as the date this rejection letter was sent. Without the posting date, Bekanntgabe and therefore the one-month deadline cannot be pinned to an exact calendar day.

warnings: The letter's own issue/posting date is missing from the text provided, so the statutory deemed-delivery date (and hence the exact one-month Klage deadline) cannot be computed; the person should check the physical letter for a date or postmark and, to be safe, treat the deadline as one month from whenever they actually received it.
Do not confuse the applicant's request date (02.07.2026, 'Ihren Antrag vom 02.07.2026') with the letter's own date - they are different dates.
